description: This file defines the class ADODB2_generic, which extends ADODB_DataDict, and includes methods for mapping metadata types to database types, as well as SQL generation stubs for altering and dropping columns. It is part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer for PHP, specifically related to generic data dictionary handling.

classes.name: ADODB2_generic
classes.description: A class for handling generic database data dictionary operations within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps a metadata type code to its corresponding database type string, supporting custom meta types.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub method for generating SQL to alter a column; not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub method for generating SQL to drop a column; not supported in this implementation.
